BiblicalUsage: Laadah, spelled Ladah in the King James Version, appears once, in the genealogy of Judah in 1 Chronicles 4:21. He was the father of Mareshah, of the families that wrought fine linen, and a son of Shelah of the house of Judah.
TheologicalSignificance: In my reading, the linen-makers of Mareshah are worth remembering: the genealogy keeps the craftsmen beside the kings, and God keeps the workers in the record.
